title: Missingness-Conditioned Spatio-Temporal Fusion for Human Activity Recognition from Low-Quality Wearable Sensor Data
abstract: arXiv:2605.00913v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Body-worn sensor networks capture human activities through complementary views, where nodes, modalities, and axes partially describe the underlying motion. In real deployments, hardware faults, wireless dropouts, and loose attachments often cause entire channels or nodes to go missing, while environmental interference degrades the remaining signals. The common impute-then-recognize pipeline introduces reconstruction errors that cannot be observed or corrected at inference. We propose the Missingness-Conditioned Spatio-Temporal Network (MCSTN), an end-to-end framework for robust activity recognition under imperfect sensing. MCSTN has three components: a structured imperfection generator that simulates point, temporal-block, axis, modality, and node failures, plus noise at varying signal-to-noise levels; a mask-aware representation that conditions node embeddings, attention, and temporal aggregation on the availability mask; and

translated_title: 缺失条件化时空融合：面向低质量可穿戴传感器数据的人体活动识别
translated_abstract: 穿戴式传感器网络通过互补的视角捕捉人体活动，其中节点、模态和轴各自部分地描述了潜在的运动。在实际部署中，硬件故障、无线中断和佩戴松动常常导致整个通道或节点完全缺失，而环境干扰则会降低剩余信号的质量。常见的“先插补、后识别”流程会引入在推理阶段无法观测也无法纠正的重构误差。我们提出了缺失条件化时空网络，这是一个面向不完美传感条件下鲁棒活动识别的端到端框架。MCSTN 包含三个组件：一个结构化缺陷生成器，用于模拟点缺失、时间块缺失、轴向缺失、模态缺失和节点故障，以及不同信噪比水平下的噪声；一个掩码感知的表示模块，依据可用性掩码对节点嵌入、注意力机制和时间聚合进行条件化；以及……
tldr: 提出缺失条件化时空网络（MCSTN），通过结构化模拟各类传感器缺失与噪声，并利用可用性掩码对时空表示进行条件化，实现对低质量可穿戴传感器数据的端到端鲁棒人体活动识别。
en_tdlr: MCSTN is an end-to-end missingness-conditioned spatio-temporal network that achieves robust human activity recognition from low-quality wearable sensor data by simulating structured channel/node failures with noise and conditioning spatio-temporal representations on availability masks.
